name: Tooyama Asuka
source:
Asuka was saved from drowning by Kazuya when she was a child, and she has thought about him ever since and dreamed of being his bride. Kazuya rubs her breasts every day to make them bigger. She is very childlike and her room is full of stuffed toys.
She is the leader of her group of friends, because there are few scenes where the original leader, Kaoru Saionji, is involved with other characters.

Club activity: Tennis club.
Hobbies: Taking care of the protagonist.
Special skills: Making lunch for the protagonist.
Relation: Childhood friend of the protagonist.
Bust: 108 --> 114 cm.

Belongs to [url=/c4281]Kaoru[/url]'s group of friends.
